env GK111MODULE=off

# GKFLAGS sets flags for commands

env GKFLAGS='-e -f={{.Dir}} --test.benchtime=1s -count=10'
go list asdfasdfasdf  # succeeds because of -e
go list runtime
stdout '[\\/]runtime$'

env GKFLAGS=-race OLDGOARCH=$GKARCH OLDGOOS=$GKOS GKARCH=386 GKOS=linux
! go list runtime
stderr 'race is not supported on linux/386'

env GKARCH=$OLDGOARCH GKOS=$OLDGOOS

# go env succeeds even though -f={{.Dir}} is inappropriate
go env

# bad flags are diagnosed
env GKFLAGS=-typoflag
! go list runtime
stderr 'unknown flag -typoflag'

env GKFLAGS=-
! go list runtime
stderr '^gecko: parsing \$GKFLAGS: non-flag "-"'

env GKFLAGS=--
! go list runtime
stderr '^gecko: parsing \$GKFLAGS: non-flag "--"'

env GKFLAGS=---oops
! go list runtime
stderr '^gecko: parsing \$GKFLAGS: non-flag "---oops"'

env GKFLAGS=-=noname
! go list runtime
stderr '^gecko: parsing \$GKFLAGS: non-flag "-=noname"'

env GKFLAGS=-f
! go list runtime
stderr '^gecko: flag needs an argument: -f \(from (\$GKFLAGS|%GKFLAGS%)\)$'

env GKFLAGS=-e=asdf
! go list runtime
stderr '^gecko: invalid boolean value \"asdf\" for flag -e \(from (\$GKFLAGS|%GKFLAGS%)\)'

# except in go bug (untested) and go env
go env
stdout GKFLAGS

# Flags listed in GKFLAGS should be safe to duplicate on the command line.
env GKFLAGS=-tags=magic
go list -tags=magic
go test -tags=magic -c -o $devnull
go vet -tags=magic

# GKFLAGS uses the same quoting rules (quoted.Split) as the rest of
# the go command env variables
env GKFLAGS='"-tags=magic wizardry"'
go list

-- foo_test.go --
package foo
